title: Typed deterministic verification specs for VC4 Codegen Milestone 2
notes: M2 is an example milestone consumed by generic milestone automation: descriptor + worklist + verifications + context profiles + prompts.
Future milestones provide their own descriptor and milestone-specific files without changing generic verifier, autorun, resume, or router scripts.
M1-specific expected state is not a persistent acceptance target; M2 and later milestones are cumulative.
The verifier script is cumulative and remains pro_scripts/vc4_milestone_verifier.py for backward compatibility.
M2 introduces general program-bundle mechanisms; a single-kernel bundle is a kernels.length == 1 program.
Hardware entries are marked requires_hardware and may be skipped only with --no-hardware.
M2 slice 5 owns emit-launch-abi-header, emit-launcher-uniform-packing, and emit-saxpy-full-qasm-artifact-regression; m2-00 excludes them so the scaffold probe stays slice-local.
Regex entries in generated_runtime_contract are Python regular expressions and must use single JSON escaping, e.g. "PUT32\\s*\\(" in JSON for regex PUT32\s*\(.
M2 slice 6 reference_hardware probes are side-effect cleaned by the verifier; checked-in reference trees are source inputs, not generated-output sinks.
M2 static runtime/layout contracts are stop_on_failure gates: generated launch code must call vc4LaunchKernel while invariant libpi runtime owns raw V3D enqueue and bounded wait behavior.
M2 slice 6 keeps heap_size_bytes at the established M2 persistent-heap scale (at least 65536 bytes); shrinking back to a tiny/default heap is treated as a regression before hardware.
Post-slice-6 anti-shortcut checks keep QASM emission scheduled-stream based and prevent support-script VC4_TEST_RESULT/runtime-event injection in later hardware slices.

vpm_setup_clobber is a physical-QPU/VPM setup hardware-characterization litmus, not a required M2 codegen fixture; it remains useful post-M2 for validating whether conservative VPM setup serialization can be relaxed.

argv:
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys

p = Path('compiler/lib/Target/VC4/VC4ArtifactEmitter.cpp')
text = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
fixtures = [
    'minimal_thrend', 'memory_output', 'read_nop_write', 'saxpy_full',
    'multi_kernel_chain', 'saxpy_16', 'saxpy_basic',
    'global_store_coalesced_multi', 'gemv_naive_tail', 'saxpy_tmu',
    'saxpy_tmu_overlap', 'tmu_read_nop_write', 'tmu_strided_load',
    'sfu_recip', 'vpm_setup_clobber', 'vpm_slice_visibility',
    'qpu_barrier_syncthreads', 'warp_reduce_sum', 'warp_prefix_sum',
    'block_reduce_sum', 'shared_transpose_16x16',
]
found = []
for name in fixtures:
    camel = ''.join(part.capitalize() for part in name.split('_'))
    checks = [
        rf'\b(?:launchABI\.)?publicName\s*==\s*"{re.escape(name)}"',
        rf'"{re.escape(name)}"\s*==\s*(?:launchABI\.)?publicName',
        rf'\b(?:append|emit|write){camel}(?:QASM|Runtime|Kernel|Launch)\b',
        rf'\b(?:append|emit|write).*{re.escape(name)}.*(?:QASM|Runtime|Kernel|Launch)\b',
    ]
    for pattern in checks:
        if re.search(pattern, text):
            found.append(f'{name}: /{pattern}/')
required = [
    'scheduledStream',
    'emitQPUBundleQASM',
    'emitQPULDIQASM',
    'emitQPUSemaQASM',
    'emitQPUBranchQASM',
]
missing = [item for item in required if item not in text]
if found or missing:
    if found:
        print('forbidden fixture/public-name codegen special cases found:')
        for item in found:
            print('  ' + item)
    if missing:
        print('generic scheduled-stream QASM emitter pieces missing: ' + ', '.join(missing))
    sys.exit(1)

from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys

p = Path('compiler/lib/Target/VC4/VC4ArtifactEmitter.cpp')
text = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
fixtures = [
    'minimal_thrend', 'memory_output', 'read_nop_write', 'saxpy_full',
    'multi_kernel_chain', 'saxpy_16', 'saxpy_basic',
    'global_store_coalesced_multi', 'gemv_naive_tail', 'saxpy_tmu',
    'saxpy_tmu_overlap', 'tmu_read_nop_write', 'tmu_strided_load',
    'sfu_recip', 'vpm_setup_clobber', 'vpm_slice_visibility',
    'qpu_barrier_syncthreads', 'warp_reduce_sum', 'warp_prefix_sum',
    'block_reduce_sum', 'shared_transpose_16x16',
]
found = []
for name in fixtures:
    camel = ''.join(part.capitalize() for part in name.split('_'))
    checks = [
        rf'\b(?:launchABI\.)?publicName\s*==\s*"{re.escape(name)}"',
        rf'"{re.escape(name)}"\s*==\s*(?:launchABI\.)?publicName',
        rf'\b(?:append|emit|write){camel}(?:QASM|Runtime|Kernel|Launch)\b',
        rf'\b(?:append|emit|write).*{re.escape(name)}.*(?:QASM|Runtime|Kernel|Launch)\b',
    ]
    for pattern in checks:
        if re.search(pattern, text):
            found.append(f'{name}: /{pattern}/')
required = [
    'scheduledStream',
    'emitQPUBundleQASM',
    'emitQPULDIQASM',
    'emitQPUSemaQASM',
    'emitQPUBranchQASM',
]
missing = [item for item in required if item not in text]
if found or missing:
    if found:
        print('forbidden fixture/public-name codegen special cases found:')
        for item in found:
            print('  ' + item)
    if missing:
        print('generic scheduled-stream QASM emitter pieces missing: ' + ', '.join(missing))
    sys.exit(1)
